incidents.name: Peapods TokenRewards paired-LP price manipulation
incidents.notes: TokenRewards.depositFromPairedLpToken() valued the paired LP token from the live pOHM/PEAS Uniswap V3 pool, so a flash-swapped pOHM sale that moved that pool inside one transaction let the attacker have the reward accounting credit far more than the deposit was worth.

sources.ref: onchain review: TokenRewards 0x7d48D6D775FaDA207291B37E3eaA68Cc865bf9Eb created 2024-01-25T19:44:11Z by 0x21fe3e26e824783ca7e374355a8d30ae8bbf6e37, not the attack-tx sender 0xedee6379fe90bd9b85d8d0b767d4a6deb0dc9dcf; no EIP-1967 events, 379.5 days old. Classified oracle-manipulation because the contract behaved as written and the attacker moved the price it reads. Reported loss ~$3,500, above the $1,000 floor.
